other_conditions: Must have a sanctioned term loan for Gross Fixed Capital Investment.
Loan disbursement date must be on or after 01/01/2024 for units under implementation as of 01/10/2024.
Application must be submitted within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
Unit must be in regular repayment of installments and interest.
Unit must bear at least 2% interest on the term loan.
Eligible activities include Garments, Apparel & Made‑ups, Technical Textiles (including Composite Unit).

Eligible activities include Weaving (with or without preparatory), Knitting, Dyeing & Processing, Texturising, Twisting, Embroidery and MMF Spinning of polyester or viscose staple fiber (excluding cotton and synthetic filament yarn).
benefits_summary: Offers a credit‑linked interest subsidy of up to 7% on term loans for 5‑8 years, with a maximum subsidy of 2‑3% of the estimated Fixed Capital Investment per annum depending on category.
